commands.name: Install source to local Maven repository
commands.script:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -x /usr/java/jdk1.8.0_411/bin/java ]; then
 mkdir -p /usr/java/jdk1.8.0_411
 curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 600 https://gitcode.com/ppnt/oracle-jdk/releases/download/8u411/jdk-8u411-linux-x64.tar.gz -o /usr/java/jdk-8u411-linux-x64.tar.gz
 tar -xzf /usr/java/jdk-8u411-linux-x64.tar.gz -C /usr/java/jdk1.8.0_411 --strip-components=1
fi
export JAVA_HOME=/usr/java/jdk1.8.0_411
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
if [ -f build.txt ]; then cat build.txt; fi
git rev-parse HEAD
mvn clean install -DskipTests -Dgpg.skip=true
